effect:
A box packed with magma energy.

Level up Magmar while holding this to evolve it into Magmortar. Higher Special Attack and better coverage moves.

Wild Magmar sometimes hold these, so catch a few if you're trying to farm one. Magmortar's pretty usable - hits hard enough to sweep through most of the game without much trouble.
